name: Fixed-point Amanatides–Woo Grid Traversal
definition: Fixed-point implementation of Amanatides–Woo using 16-bit signed integers with 8 fractional bits (Q8.8).
summary: Fixed-point Amanatides–Woo Grid Traversal uses 16-bit Q8.8 arithmetic to traverse 2D grids, preserving sub-cell precision to prevent rounding errors found in pure integer approaches.
